title: Advantage-Weighted Regression: Simple and Scalable Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning
notes: Ref3 pilot borrows value/advantage-weighted regression: real physical returns fit action-conditioned Q and Q-derived weights train trajectory actor. Fixed 24-step truncated behavior-continuation return, deterministic actor, rank33 decaying exploration, diagonal normalized squared-error surrogate and explicit parameter trust interpolation are project adaptations. This does not reproduce AWR/QWR algorithms or their theoretical guarantees. No gradients through frozen PW.
